suggestions: What's the difference between a regular and an irregular cycle?

landing.title: Understand your cycle, ask with confidence
landing.subtitle: CycleCare is an educational assistant that answers from reviewed sources, tracks your cycle, and prepares questions for your doctor — no diagnosis, no prescriptions.
landing.cta_login: I have an account — log in
landing.note: Sign-up is simple: a few questions help us understand you and tailor answers. Your data stays in your browser.
landing.f1_body: Every answer comes from reviewed knowledge and always ends with a consult-your-doctor line.
landing.f2_body: Log cycles and symptoms and see insights from your data — analysed locally, offline.
landing.f3_body: A summary of your cycles plus a question list to take to your appointment.
landing.f4_body: A language filter stops dangerous content and gives you the emergency number right away.
landing.disclaimer: CycleCare is educational only — it does not diagnose or prescribe.

signup.title: Sign-up form
signup.subtitle: A few simple questions so we can understand you
signup.q_age_hint: Helps us tailor information to your age.
signup.q_cycles: How many cycles have you had so far?
signup.q_cycles_hint: An estimate is enough — you can change it later in “My data”.
signup.q_avg: What is your average cycle length in days?
signup.q_avg_hint: From the first day of bleeding to the day before the next period. 21–35 days is common.
signup.q_last: Date of the first day of your last period
signup.q_last_hint: We log it in the tracker to estimate your next period — you can skip it.
signup.q_country_hint: So we can show the right emergency number.
signup.opt_hint: Feel free to skip — you can add these later in “My data”.
signup.ph_conditions: One per line: condition name | diagnosed or unsure
signup.done_title: All set! Your profile is ready
signup.done_body: We saved your answers in this browser — edit them anytime from “My data”.
signup.err_age: If you enter an age, keep it between 10 and 60 — or leave it empty.
signup.err_cycles: Pick a number from 0 to 200 — or leave it empty.
signup.err_avg: Pick a number from 15 to 60 days — or leave it empty.
signup.err_last: Pick a valid date — or leave the field empty.
